title: Fix Demonstrator Panel Layout And Set Active Example Errors
description: Fix invalid 3 panel layout size percentage error in react-resizable-panels and migrate active example/contributions action dispatching to typed command channel in demonstrator.
summary: Fixed demonstrator panel layout error and setActiveExample / setContributions warnings. Root Cause 1: ResizablePanelGroup in renderModeDockNode lacked an explicit defaultLayout array and dynamic key containing child count, causing react-resizable-panels to validate stale 2-panel layout state against 3 child panels. Fixed by supplying a normalized defaultLayout array summing to 100% and dynamic group keys. Root Cause 2: setActiveExample and setContributions were dispatched via onAction / handleAction ({ kind: 'action' }) which Rust VcsDocumentApp::dispatch_action rejected as non-reserved framework actions. Fixed by migrating setActiveExample and setContributions dispatches to handleCommand ({ kind: 'command' }). Verified via 300 passing unit tests in framework-renderer-react.
